metadata.description: Deterministic desktop chat tier (D19). Named test:e2e so `nx affected -t test:e2e` selects it, and built unpackaged so the Electron shell can run under xvfb on the CI e2e runner. Infrastructure bring-up is `scripts/ensure-services.sh`, shared with every other tier here: it publishes the bootstrap billing policy only on a database that has none, because that publish pins `--expected-head-revision 0` and dies on any database whose head has moved (C65/P70).

commands: ../../node_modules/.bin/vitest run --config vitest.config.ts src/desktop-chat-in-project.spec.ts src/desktop-chat-replay.spec.ts src/desktop-chat-launcher-2.spec.ts src/desktop-mcp-fixture.spec.ts src/desktop-chat-attachments.spec.ts src/desktop-share-link-copy.spec.ts

metadata.description: The kernel-utility cap gate (R5 of docs/research/electron-kernel-utility-cap-blueprint.md): nine live projects in one window, a get_kernel_result turn in the ninth, and the park and return of a hidden one. Kept off test:e2e because the row holds nine kernel utilities at once and waits out the 2-minute park window, neither of which is proven on the Ubuntu e2e runner; promote it once it has been observed green there.

Packaged-app specs (macOS arm64 only: they launch package-out/Tau-darwin-arm64). Kept off `test:e2e` so the Ubuntu e2e runner is not asked for a package it cannot build. `TAU_E2E_DESKTOP_EXECUTABLE` is assigned on the vitest command rather than in `env` because the Assimp spec requires an absolute path and Nx strips a leading `{workspaceRoot}/` from option values.

External-agent tier (W4-ACP): the desktop's ACP rows, and one real turn through the operator's own Codex login. Kept off test:e2e because it spends their quota and needs the Codex CLI; the spec skips when the adapter or the CLI is absent.

W18 two-client tier: chromium.launch() beside electron.launch() in one node-side vitest process, a real UI server on :3014 (apps/ui/server.ts, started by the spec), the dedicated API on :4014, and a git http-backend fixture in mktemp. Kept off test:e2e because it needs the built web UI as well as the desktop shell, and six of its cases are red pins on product defects. No dependsOn api:build: that chain reaches runtime:build, which is red on Node 24 for a tsdown config-loader bug, and global-setup.ts builds apps/api itself. The web UI is built by the first command rather than a dependsOn, because it must be the cloud variant (TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED=true is a build-time input of ui:build) and a dependency task inherits only the caller's environment: a self-host build hands every account canSyncFiles and renders no plan gate, so the entitlement and Upgrade rows could never be observed.

commands: TAU_CLOUD_ENABLED=true pnpm --dir ../.. exec nx run ui:build
